resources.string: Test the speed, and find out if a card is fake
No SD card or USB drive is ready. Insert one, or wait until it shows up in Storage.
Writes and reads a 256 MB file. Takes about a minute.
Fine for games. Copying and saving large files is slow.
Slow: expect long loading times, especially for PSP, Dreamcast and N64 games.
Fills the free space (%1$s) with test data, reads it all back and then deletes it. A fake card that claims more space than it has fails this. Takes about %2$s.

Fills the free space (%1$s) with test data, reads it all back and then deletes it. A fake card that claims more space than it has fails this. Takes hours on a big card; test the speed first for a better estimate.
Looking for signs of a fake card…
Writing test data: %1$s of %2$s, about %3$s left
Reading it back: %1$s of %2$s, about %3$s left
Stopping and deleting the test data…
Passed. All %1$s of test data came back as written. This card is real.
Failed. %1$s of test data came back wrong, starting after about %2$s. The card is fake or damaged and only really holds about %3$s. Copy your games off it and use a different card.
Failed. This card is fake: it starts over at its own beginning after about %1$s, so it only really holds that much. Keep your games below that, or better, use a different card.
The check caught it while writing and put the start of the card back.
The check caught it while writing, but could not put the start of the card back. The console may not start from this card any more: back up your games.
Failed. The card reported an error after %1$s of test data. It may be damaged or fake.
Stopped. The test data was deleted.
There isn\'t enough free space for the test.
The card reported a write error.
The card reported a read error.

This fills all the free space on %1$s for about %2$s, so games can\'t save there until it is done. Plug in the charger: the console stays awake. You can stop at any time. Your games and files are not touched.
Consoles are often sold with fake or worn out cards. A fake card claims to be bigger than it is, and games copied past its real end come back broken. The check writes only to free space.
